MINIMUM WAGES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012
<http://salmankhangolra.blogspot.com/2012/05/minimum-wages-amendment-act-2012.html> <http://salmankhangolra.blogspot.com/2012/05///www.blogger.com/post-edit.g?blogID=527540665958900589&postID=3595185065534866983&from=pencil>
An Act further to amend the Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary
11th February 2012]
No.PAP/Legis-2(90)/2011/528,
dated 11-02-2012.---The Minimum Wages (Amendment)
Bill, 2011, originally passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the
21st day of December 2011, was sent to the Governor of the Punjab
for assent. The Governor returned the Bill for reconsideration by the Assembly.
The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab, after
reconsideration, again passed the Bill on the 25th day of January 2012. The
Bill was again sent to the Governor for assent on the 27th day of January 2012.
Since the Governor has not assented to the Bill within the stipulated period of
ten days, the same is deemed to have been assented to in terms of clause (3) of
Article 116 of the Constitution, and is published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.---Whereas it
is expedient further to amend the Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961 (XXXIX of 1961)
for purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is enacted as follows:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be cited as the Minimum Wages (Amendment) Act, 2012.
(2) It shall come into force
at once.

Amendment in Ordinance XXXIX of 1961
